newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's IRI seeks coordinator for Autostrade sale.
newsitem.headline: Italy's IRI seeks coordinator for Autostrade sale.

text.p: Italian industrial holding IRI said on Thursday its board had approved the procedure for selecting the global coordinator to oversee the sell-off of its motorway operator unit Autostrade.
IRI said in a statement it had sent the plan of procedure along with a list of candidate banks to a government committee on privatisation for approval.
The privatisation could be completed by the start of the summer, Treasury minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi told parliament last Tuesday.
IRI also said it had begun looking for a legal consultant, an advertising agency and a global communications consultant for the privatisation of Autostrade. (( -- Rome newsroom +396 678 2505 ))
